question: Do inherited developmental genomes produce repeatable behavioural or reproductive differences, and do their lineage frequencies respond consistently across independent populations? Adaptation, fitness increase, and mutation advantage are not tested and will not be claimed.
known_conditions_declared_in_advance: Only two of sixteen loci are expressed in the live brain: locus 6 sets connection stride (1 + l6 mod 15) and locus 13 sets plasticity scale (1 + l13 / 16).

Mutation changes each locus with probability 0.012 per birth by -2..+2, so an expressed change is expected in only about 2 percent of births. Heritable variation is therefore expected to come almost entirely from standing variation among founders; mutation's contribution is reported but cannot be established without expressed mutants.

In Experiment 001 every individual was killed by zombies at the first VoxeLibre nightfall (about 11.4 minutes), and newborns reusing a dead body's slot spawned among the zombies and died within 15 seconds. This authentic survival pressure is kept; it is expected to limit generation depth and statistical power.

genetics.seed_rule: first seed >= 101 not used by any earlier experiment whose four founders have pairwise distinct expressed (connection_stride, plasticity_scale)
genetics.genome_rotation: body slot s of a run with rotation r develops from founder ordinal (s + r) mod 4; identities 1..4 and slots 0..3 stay fixed, so genotype is crossed with slot and identity-keyed receptor noise

world.game: VoxeLibre survival with mobs and day-night cycle

evolution.outcome_per_replicate: lineage births per founder genotype: births whose founder ancestor carries that genotype, from exact lineage reconstruction

common_garden.acquired_state: every individual is a newborn with empty acquired state
common_garden.note: no birth can occur, so each block measures the four genotypes side by side; the rotation places each genotype once in each slot (a Latin square)

phenotypes.P2_reproductive_signal_rate: fraction of transitions with reproduction signal_0 > 0
phenotypes.P3_locomotor_activity: fraction of transitions whose action has nonzero thrust or strafe, or jump > 0

decision_rules.H1_repeatable_behavioural_difference: for at least one of P1, P2, P3: exact within-block permutation test (all 24^4 relabelings of genotype within each block), statistic = sum over genotypes of the squared mean of block-centred values, p <= 0.05 / 3
decision_rules.H2_consistent_lineage_response: Kendall's W of genotype ranks by lineage births (average ranks for ties) over informative replicates (total births > 0); requires at least 6 informative replicates; permutation p <= 0.05 from 20000 within-replicate shuffles with RNG seed 20261023
decision_rules.conclusion: selectable heritable behavioural variation is demonstrated only if H1 and H2 both pass; otherwise the result is reported as not demonstrated, with each part stated separately
secondary_report_only: Spearman correlation between genotype mean P2 in the garden and total lineage births in evolution
expressed mutations, maximum generation, births, deaths, stop reasons
mob attacks on founder bodies from the server log, and the time of the first death in each run
blocked reproduction by reason; infrastructure blocks separated from biological outcomes

validity: every run writes a population report and its lineage reconstruction agrees with every live manifest genome
infrastructure-blocked reproduction is reported separately and never counted as a biological outcome

exclusions_and_stopping.runs: all 12 runs exactly once in the fixed order evolution 0..7 then garden 0..3; no additional replicates
exclusions_and_stopping.infrastructure_failure: a run whose processes fail before writing a report is rerun once before any result is inspected; a second failure stops the experiment as incomplete
exclusions_and_stopping.frozen_build: the driver refuses a dirty tracked tree and runs every phase from a snapshot binary, bridge mod, and analysis script copied into the run directory
exclusions_and_stopping.after_outcomes: this file is not revised after any Experiment 002 outcome is generated
